text:
sam: kicking off deploy - model-route-v4 -> will unpause routing flag gradually. plan: enable `model_route_v4` at 10% for 10m, then 30% for 10m, then 100% if green. tagging release notes + rollback plan. deploy-id=rn-2026-03-23-01
deploy-bot: starting rollout rn-2026-03-23-01 on infra pool eu-west-1. jobs: 24 tasks. ETA ~12m :gear:
maria: noted. pushing release notes to docs now. pinging @kai to watch latency heatmap :eyes:
kai: on it, will watch 95p latency and error rate. set alert thresholds: +20% latency OR +0.5% error -> hold
sam: adding a soft holdpoint after 20m and a pin to previous model if any threshold hits. pin config snippet:
```json
{
  "flag": "model_route_v4",
  "initial_percent": 10,
  "steps": [10,30,100],
  "hold_on_signal": true,
  "pin_to": "model_route_v3"
}
```
deploy-bot: rollout at 10% complete. traffic slice created. logs: `slice-17`
kai: 1m in: latency +3% overall, fine. no errors. continuing :thumbsup:
olivia: quick note: customer-facing release notes include mention of small routing change and fallback behavior. added to RN draft.
deploy-bot: moving to 30% step now. schedule: next check in 10m.
kai: watch - 7m into 30% and p95 is drifting +18%, tail trending up, small spike in mem for two tasks. investigating.
maria: can we slow the ramp to 20% until we confirm? suggestion: split 30% -> 20% for 10m then reassess.
sam: agree. slowing ramp. updating rollout plan and console settings.
deploy-bot: adjusted traffic to 20% per request from sam. new slice: `slice-17a`.
kai: continuing to watch. p95 still +17%, error rate flat. suspect kv-cache pressure. I'll run a quick heap check on the two nodes.
olivia: holding public release note finalization until green.
kai: heap ok, but GC pauses correlated with larger batch sizes from this slice. recommending reduce batch size or revert.
sam: decision time - reduce batch config for v4 or pin back to v3. what's the impact estimate?
maria: reducing batch size should mitigate tail latency within 10-15m but could increase token-cost by ~3%. pin rollback will restore baseline immediately but loses new routing perf gains.
sam: prefer try config tweak first. roll forward with reduced batching at 20% for 15m. if p95 > +15% or errors > +0.5%, auto-pin to v3 and notify.
kai: applying batch config change now: `--max-batch-tokens=1024` -> was 2048.
deploy-bot: config patch applied to slices serving v4.
kai: 10m after tweak: p95 down to +8%, errors stable. looks good.
olivia: ok to finalize release notes: noting conservative ramp and batch tweak, callout to follow-up ticket RN-1234 for perf tuning.
sam: thanks everyone. leaving ramp to reach 100% over next hour with autoscaling. will record rollback rationale in release doc. closing thread once RN published. :white_check_mark:
